name: trackiq-amazon-search-visibility-audit
title: TrackIQ: Amazon Search Visibility Audit
summary: Audits where an Amazon brand's ASINs actually appear in search — organic rank per revenue-bearing query, the terms bought but not ranked, the terms ranked and still paid for, share of voice, and the revenue sitting behind the queries the brand is absent from.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. file needs a filesystem, n8n needs network, slack and email need their tool connected. Outward sends confirm first.

fallback: Works from a rank-tracker export, a Search Query Performance export and a search-term report plus revenue by ASIN. Every section except share-of-voice movement is reproducible that way.
